title: PG-18.1 Interop SDKs, A2A and payments (memev)
request: Programme contract for work package WP18 in memev: Interop SDKs, A2A and payments. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. Source: the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 (docs/scope-one/programme/WBS.md, docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md, docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/WP18.json) and the owner notes behind docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md. Depends on tasks outside this contract: WP02-04, WP04-02, WP10-03. Depends on contracts: SO-2.08, SO-1.04. Covers only what the Scope One contracts (SO-1.01 to SO-1.11) do not already cover; the mapping is in contracts/programme/manifest.json. Boundary with SO-2.08 and SO-1.04: WP18-02 is the first framework adapter (LangGraph first); SO-2.08 covers every other framework and runtime. Boundary with SO-2.07 and SO-2.09 to SO-2.11: specialist, delivery, communication and enterprise systems are not taken here; WP18 covers the agent protocol, the SDK, conformance and payments. Signed vault contract SO-05-B (cited by id only): per-client capability records; WP18-02 reads them and defines no second record.  Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the WO-05-A call-out boundary (never vendored, no memev-merge); tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier.
